title: Assess engineering model conformance
description: Model authors and reviewers can determine which rules govern a selected model, identify mechanically checkable violations, and understand the scope and limits of a conformance result before relying on the model.

includes: Identify the selected metamodel and representation profile, including retained historical selections.
Check declared record, identity, naming, containment, reference, cardinality, and lifecycle rules.
Report actionable diagnostics and distinguish conformance from engineering-review conclusions.
excludes: Automatic proof of requirement satisfaction, semantic adequacy, or approval.
Support for every historical representation by the current interpreter.

sources.basis: IR-005 and its Scenario/SR analysis establish this bounded stakeholder capability; it remains draft analysis, not an implemented feature claim.
